blocks.text: MIAMI — Klay Thompson is going back to California. His shooting groove evidently is making the trip. Thompson’s slow start to the season seems to be over, after he made seven 3-pointers — five of them coming in a seven-minute barrage of the third quarter that blew the game open — and helped the Miami Heat beat the Indiana Pacers 145-125 on Friday night. He was shooting 32% from beyond the arc in his first five games with the Heat. A 7-for-12 night later, he’s up to 39%. “It wasn’t the best start to the season,” Thompson said after the 54th […]...
